verdict.rationale: MotherDuck exposes much of its functionality programmatically. It ships official SDKs, a CLI and a Postgres endpoint. Its remote MCP server runs read-write SQL and generates visualizations, and secrets, DuckLake databases and usage data are all handled through SQL. An OpenAPI spec was probed at /openapi.json, but nothing documents full parity between the API and the UI. Missing for 10: an explicit documented claim of API/UI parity, evidence of API coverage for org/user/role administration and billing management, details of what the OpenAPI spec covers, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Connect to MotherDuck using official drivers and APIs for various programming languages.
Your agents can now INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, create tables, and modify schemas through the MCP — not just SELECT.
The MotherDuck **remote** MCP Server lets you analyze your data using natural language and generate interactive visualizations, all without writing SQL.
You can safely store your Amazon S3 credentials in MotherDuck for convenience by creating a `SECRET` object
MotherDuck provides SQL views and a billing dashboard to help you understand your compute and storage consumption.
